mission: Build a RAG pipeline over a small document corpus with one market-data anchor. Your hard budget is ₹150. The vector workload is approximately 20 queries. Buy only what the task needs. For every purchase, state your reasoning — it is signed and permanently audit-logged.

args.rationale: LLM inference needed to process and embed document corpus for RAG pipeline. 100k token quota sufficient for initial document processing and question-answer generation.
First vector search query to validate document retrieval after embedding corpus into vector store.
Second vector query to test retrieval quality across different document sections and query types.
Testing vector search with varied query embeddings to measure accuracy and recall.
Vector query to benchmark recall and precision metrics for the RAG pipeline retrieval component.
Additional vector search for edge case and negative-match document retrieval testing.
Cross-reference verification query to validate consistency across related document chunks.
Seventh vector query for comprehensive coverage testing across the full document corpus.
Eighth vector query completing threshold for day pass evaluation. Cost-efficiency analysis follows.
Day pass is cost-effective: 8 paid queries already done (₹40), remaining ~12 queries at ₹5 each = ₹60 vs pass at ₹49. Pass saves ₹11 and removes per-call friction for remaining work.
Market data snapshot provides the real-time financial data anchor required by the RAG pipeline specification.
